title: Signal Health Card Contract
description: Governs the verifiable multi-dimensional statistical and epistemic health audit of collective deliberation signals before they qualify for institutional presentation or public policy consideration.
invariants: COLLECTIVE_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_SIGNAL: Raw vote aggregates do not constitute Signal without passing minimum integrity and diversity thresholds.
MINIMUM_SAMPLE_SIZE_GATE: A minimum core participant count (n >= 100) is mandatory for any statistical qualification.
BOT_ANOMALY_RESISTANCE: Astroturfing and coordinated inauthentic behavior must score >= 0.85 integrity.
DELIBERATION_DEPTH_REQUIREMENT: Epistemic depth requires reflection time and reason-articulation over knee-jerk voting.
TEMPORAL_VALIDITY_ENFORCEMENT: Decayed or stale signals must degrade to ARCHIVED status after their half-life boundary.
